tarjetas.escala_ayuda.texto: Make atoms and molecules bigger to see them better (with the camera, you can also pinch with two fingers)

mesa.vacia.texto: Tap «Add element» and pick it from the periodic table.

ajuste.ajustes_texto.texto: Opens the camera with your cards and a panel to tune live how they are read and tracked. Saved on this device.

ajuste.explicacion.texto: Put cards in front of the camera and move the sliders: changes show instantly. Green = tracked, yellow = confirming, red = rejected.

ajuste.umbral.texto: How ink is told from paper

ajuste.mismaMesa.texto: All cards on the same table (shared tilt: less jitter)

ajuste.bitsErroneos_ayuda.texto: More: reads worse-printed or distant cards; too many may mix them up.

ajuste.anchoDeteccion_ayuda.texto: More: farther cards and sharper corners, but slower.

ajuste.papelRelativo_ayuda.texto: How much darker than its surroundings a point must be to count as ink. More: ignores grid paper lines.

ajuste.papelVentana_ayuda.texto: Size of the area each point is compared with.

ajuste.movimientoRelativo_ayuda.texto: Less: keeps reading when the image blurs while moving.

ajuste.confirmar_ayuda.texto: A new card appears after being seen this many times. Less: appears sooner; more: fewer ghosts.

ajuste.reservar_ayuda.texto: How long a known card keeps its place and atom when unseen.

ajuste.perder_ayuda.texto: Unseen for this long, it disappears. More: no flicker when moving fast; less: goes sooner when removed.

ajuste.posicionCorte_ayuda.texto: Less: steadier when still, but more lag.

ajuste.posicionBeta_ayuda.texto: More: the virtual card keeps up when you move it.

ajuste.giroCorte_ayuda.texto: Less: steadier tilt, but more lag.

ajuste.seguirAtomo_ayuda.texto: How fast the atom catches up with its card. Less: more «floaty».

ajuste.campoVision_ayuda.texto: If the virtual card looks bigger or smaller than the real one, adjust this until they match.
